properties.headline: Tsunami Warning issued August 14 at 11:02AM PDT
properties.description: A tsunami warning is in effect. Widespread flooding is expected.
properties.instruction: Move to high ground or inland now. Do not return until officials say it is safe.

properties.headline: Tsunami Advisory issued August 14 at 11:05AM PDT
properties.description: Strong currents dangerous to those in or near the water are expected.
properties.instruction: Stay out of the water and away from beaches and waterways.
